decisions.reason: As a close-to-core line shown prominently in both 2018 and 2019, it likely has acceptable demand and low carrying cost within the firm's existing craft capabilities, so its option value remains positive.
This is a very traditional extension of the firm's established Christmas assortment, so keeping it uses existing skills and materials and requires little additional commitment.

Although it was promoted as a flagship, the product is distant from the firm's artisanal core and by 2022 the uncertainty around its value should be sufficiently resolved to favor refocusing on stronger core lines.
As a niche add-on tied to the more uncertain electronic music-box concept, it offers less standalone value and is easier to cut when resources can be redirected to the core assortment.
Despite seasonal fit, it remains an accessory to a distant product family, so once the firm reviews its broad portfolio this kind of peripheral option is relatively likely to be discontinued.
This themed pyramid builds directly on the firm's established strengths and can likely stay in the range at modest cost while serving collectors and seasonal buyers.
